neighbours.label: a common word opening a multi-word name or technical term ('Carbon County', 'point cloud'), as against the same word used plainly

quiet: The road climbs through the canyon and ends near a pleasant lake.
The survey covered a mining town in Alabama and its hills.
Our lab used careful methods and fresh samples in these assays.

notes: Card: ' Point' x6, ' Carbon', ' Open', ' RNA'. Probes: ' Carbon' before a name 0.6-0.7, 'point cloud' 0.5, 'past the point' 0.08. A shared pattern guessed from a list, tested on new names.
